plain.li: [company] Mind if I stand here with you for a while?
[company] It's a quiet day here, isn't it?
[company] How long have you lived here?
[company] We've been on the road a while, so it's good to talk to someone new.
[company,their:traders] Business is slow today, so I came over to say hello.
[fire] It's good to sit by a fire after a long walk.
[fire] I'll sit here by the fire for a while.
[fire] We don't often get to sit by a fire like this on the road.
[fire,theirLowtech] At home we sit around the fire every evening.
[warm] My hands are freezing.
[warm] It's cold out, so I need to warm up a bit.
[warm] A few minutes by the fire and I'll be fine.
[seat] My feet hurt, so I'm going to sit down.
[seat] I'll sit here and wait.
[seat] It's nice to sit on a proper bench for a change.
[shelter] I'm getting out of this rain.
[shelter] I'll wait under here until it stops.
[shelter] There's no point standing out there getting soaked.
[snack] Time for a bite to eat.
[snack] I brought some food with me, so I'll have some now.
[snack] Just a little something to keep me going.
[game] Nobody is using this, so I'll have a go.
[game] I haven't played this in a long time.
[game] Let's see if I still remember how to play.
[game,theirLowtech] We play something like this at home.
[music] I hope nobody minds if I play for a bit.
[music] I haven't played one of these in a long time.
[music] Just a short tune, and then I'll leave it be.
[stars] It's a clear night, so it's a good time to look at the stars.
[stars] I've never looked through one of these before.
[stars,theirHightech] We had one like this back home.
[art] Someone here put a lot of work into this.
[art] That's well made.
[art] I'd like to know who made this.
[pray] I'll say a short prayer here.
[pray] It's good to find a shrine to our god this far from home.
[pray] I always pray before we move on.
[animal] Easy now, let me brush you down.
[animal] You've carried a lot today, haven't you?
[animal] Let me have a look at your feet.
[animal,their:herders] I'll check on the animals while we wait.
[play] Come and play with me!
[play] You can't catch me.
[play] I'm going to run to that tree and back.
[drink] I brought my own, so don't worry.
[drink] I'll have a drink before we go on.
[drink] Just one, and then I'll stop.
[smoke] I'll just have a quick smoke.
[smoke] Don't worry, these are my own.
[pipe] Time for a pipe.
[pipe] I always have a pipe after a long walk.
[pipe] I like to smoke a pipe when we stop for a while.
[carve] I carve a little whenever we stop.
[carve] I'm making a spoon for the road.
[carve] It passes the time, and the children like the little animals I make.
[giveway] Go ahead, it's yours, I was only using it while it was free.
[giveway] Sorry, I'll get out of your way.
[giveway] Here, you have it, I'm done.
